groupRules.countBackupInConsecutiveNote: Default per guide section 5: maxConsecutiveDays is the HARD limit and counts PRIMARY days only, on real calendar days (9/22, Prompt 12 A: backup is standby). The locked import only fits this reading (Acton P,P,P,B,P on 10/17-10/21). Any-role runs (primary or backup) have a separate SOFT per-surgeon limit, surgeonRules.<id>.maxConsecutiveAnyRole, with a long-run penalty of weights.longRunPerDay per day beyond it; a surgeon with no maxConsecutiveAnyRole has no soft limit.

holidays.note: Faraz 9/21 (evening): 'The day rules are not for holidays. Anyone can be on backup for holidays unless they explicitly want that holiday off.' On a holiday-unit day the weekday-pattern rules (Khan Tue/Thu + Mon/Wed, Burchett recurring whitelist, Acton 2nd/4th Mon/Wed, Fierce Clinton days + Monday-backup-only, Philip Aledo weekday rules) are not applied to primary (since 9/22 they never apply to backup on any day - see backupPolicy). Still applied: vacations, per-surgeon holidayRules.holidaysOff, backupOptOut, maxMajorHolidays, East busy days / forecast, Fierce derived-week locks, Sarkar windows, monthly caps. 9/22 (Prompt 12 A): a holiday unit counts as ONE day for the consecutive limits only for a surgeon whose surgeonRules.<id>.holidayUnitCountsAsOneDay is true (Khan: his 4-day Thanksgiving unit vs his max 3); everyone else counts real days. The former group key unitExemptFromMaxConsecutive is gone - rules.js ignores it with a warning if an older blob still carries it.

backupPolicy.note: Backup is open to everyone, on-site or off-site, every day: outreach days, OR days, Clinton/Aledo days, the recurring whitelist, governed months and the weeks whitelist restrict PRIMARY only. Still blocking backup: vacations, holiday opt-outs, explicit unavailable / no_backup rows, East-derived weeks, the other role the same day, backup caps, Sarkar's windows and an explicit surgeonRules.<id>.backupOptOut (Setup -> Rules: 'Does not take backup'; nobody has opted out - rules doc section 8 item 7). Soft avoids (recurringAvoid) weigh low for backup and medium for primary. rules.js READS openToEveryone: false restores the pre-9/22 reading (the day rules, the dated whitelists, the Aledo week and the hardNeverWeekdays default govern both roles again); an explicit hardNeverWeekdaysRoles list and backupOptOut are honoured either way, and an absent key means open. Still counting backup until their own items land: monthly caps (item K) and max-consecutive when countBackupInConsecutive is true. Sarkar's window-week minimum bonus is a primary soft: backup inside a window is allowed but never targeted.

weights.note: Soft-penalty weights read by rules.js eligibility() and the generator score; string weights in surgeonRules (low/medium/strong/preferred) map through this table. longRunPerDay (= medium) is the penalty per day by which an any-role run exceeds the surgeon's maxConsecutiveAnyRole (9/22, Prompt 12 A).

availabilityPrecedence: time_off (+ trailing edge: the day before a vacation blocks PRIMARY)
explicit available / backup_only rows (a dated row for a role lifts the next tier for that role only)

recurring patterns (recurringUnavailable), weekday patterns (weekdays.allowed, outsideDerivedWeeks incl. weekend-block-only), windows / weeks / governed months, day-before-Aledo - since 9/22 every member of this tier except availableWindows restricts PRIMARY only (outsideDerivedWeeks is per-role data and says backup:true everywhere)

independent gates no row overrides: hardNeverWeekdays (primary only by default since 9/22 via hardNeverWeekdaysRoles; named hard on purpose: OR days, Sarkar Fri/Sun - change the rule, or override the edit with its warning), backupOptOut (hard on every backup slot), East busy, derived East weeks, caps, maxConsecutiveDays, same-day other role, holiday opt-outs
groupRules.availabilityPrecedenceNote: availableWeeks and availableWindows are read from surgeonRules directly and are NOT written as available rows: a row is a dated exception that lifts weekday patterns, and one row per window day would open Sarkar's hard-never Friday inside every window.

whitelistMonths.rule: A month is governed by an explicit date list only when it appears in surgeonRules[id].explicitListMonths (written from the seed's explicitAvailable keys, for every surgeon who has one: Burchett Oct+Dec, Acton Oct, Philip Oct). In a governed month the eligible set is exactly the explicit available/backup_only rows minus unavailable rows; in other months recurring patterns + weekendsAvailable minus unavailable rows. Dates in a list that spill into a neighbouring month are additive there and do not put that month into whitelist mode.
whitelistMonths.roleScope: An entry is 'YYYY-MM' (governs primary and backup) or { month: 'YYYY-MM', roles: ['primary'] } (governs only those roles). A role-scoped explicitAvailable list that names one role yields the scoped form; the importer and test/seed-adapter.js derive it the same way.

dayBeforeRules.note: Both day-before rules (vacation trailing edge; Philip's day-before-Aledo) apply to PRIMARY only. Matches the group's own hand schedule (Philip was backup 10/14 before his 10/15 day and backup 10/22 before Aledo Friday 10/23) and the DB trigger, which checks start_date - 1 for primary only.

locks.note: Importer: primaryLocked = locked && (primary != null || externalCover != null); backupLocked = locked && backup != null. 10/15 and the 16 open October backups stay fillable and show in diagnostics.uncovered with per-surgeon reasons; import/manual locks always beat East-derived locks (with a warning).

forecast.note: Faraz 9/21 (evening): the Davenport schedule for the next period is not out until the end of 2026. Until it is published, east-feed.js runs the Davenport generator N times over the next period with the live Davenport inputs (config blob, time off, published weeks, read the way the live East feed reads them) and derives per-day probabilities that FAK is on East call. Probability >= busyThreshold is treated as East-busy for Silvis PRIMARY (backup allowed, as on real East days); below it a soft penalty applies; such days carry a 'forecast' badge. When Davenport publishes, the real feed replaces the forecast and a conflict report lists Silvis days needing a trade.

eastFeed.note: When the feed (published or forecast) does not cover a day, Khan is treated as clear with a low soft penalty (weights.eastUnknown) and the day is listed in diagnostics; never silently busy, never silently free without a listing.

groupRules.regressionScope: Hard-rule assertions in test/generator-regression.js apply to generator-placed slots only; locks are byte-identical (item 3) and lock collisions are reported as warnings; item 1 accepts externalCover; item 13 accepts 'uncovered with reasons'.
